    Rhyme Lab

    Look up any word in the rhyme book. Perfect rhymes are listed most common first, then multi-syllable rhymes and slant rhymes.

    Do these rhyme?

    &

    Perfect
    Same sound from the last stressed vowel to the end: flow / glow.
    Multi
    A perfect rhyme across two or more syllables: nation / station.
    Slant
    Same vowels and a similar ending: time / line, orange / storage.
    Loose
    Only the last syllable or the vowel matches: happy / tree. Counts on Chill and Normal.
    Echo
    One word ends with the other: day / today. Low points.

    How it works

    1. Pick a beat. Twelve built-in beats from 78 to 142 BPM, or add your own songs. The BPM, key and beat grid are read from the audio.
    2. Ride the intro. The count-in shows the first words so you can get your first line ready.
    3. End every bar on the word. Rap whatever you want, but finish the bar on the word on screen. Land it on beat 4, the snare, where the ring sits.
    4. Pairs rhyme. Words with the same color rhyme. In couplets, bar 1 sets up the rhyme and bar 2 pays it off.
    5. Look ahead. The next words always show under the current one, and they slide along the lane at the bottom toward the moment you say them.

    Settings that change the game

    Scheme
    Couplets (AABB), Alternating (ABAB) or Four in a row (AAAA).
    Words
    Easy: short everyday words. Medium: more variety. Hard: longer words and multi-syllable pairs like terrific / horrific.
    New word
    Every bar, or every 2 bars for more room on fast beats. Auto picks 2 bars above 115 BPM.
    Word pack
    Mixed words, or a topic like Money, Food, Space or Sports for the first word of each rhyme.
    More rhymes
    Shows extra words with the same sound, for rhymes in the middle of your bars.

    Keys

    Enter
    Start the cipher.
    Space
    In the cipher: swap the upcoming words for a new rhyme. On the menu: preview the beat.
    I
    Show or hide more rhymes.
    Esc
    Pause, restart or end the session.
    ↑ ↓
    Pick a song in the crate.
    T
    Tap tempo on your own songs.

    Settings

    If new words appear before you hear the downbeat (common on Bluetooth speakers), move this to the right.
